sentences.en: and Iran are each signaling that they may be making progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗都在释放信号，表明他们可能在重新开放霍尔木兹海峡方面取得了进展。

sentences.en: But they haven't reached a deal yet.
sentences.zh: 但他们尚未达成协议。

sentences.zh: 且这一至关重要的航运通道依然处于关闭状态。

sentences.en: Hanging in the balance are thousands of crew members who have been stranded on their ships since the fighting started three months ago.
sentences.zh: 悬而未决的是数千名船员，自三个月前战斗开始以来，他们一直被困在船上。

sentences.en: Today, we hear from two seafarers who got stuck about what it's like to be trapped in the middle of this war zone and what it would mean to get everyone out.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们倾听了两位被困海员的讲述，了解身处这场战区中央是怎样一种体验，以及让所有人撤离意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月29日，星期五。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can hear you all right, yeah.
sentences.zh: 能，我听得清清楚楚，对。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for taking the time to talk with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您抽空与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Yeah, no problem, man.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题，老兄。

sentences.en: So, just to start, can you introduce yourself, please?
sentences.zh: 那么，首先请您做个自我介绍好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, my name is Captain Virendra Vishwakarma.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫维伦德拉·维什瓦卡马船长。

sentences.en: I'm sailing on LPG tankers since last five years.
sentences.zh: 我开LPG油轮已经五年了。

sentences.en: And before I was captain on oil chemical ships, I started my career in 2000.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我是石油化学品船的船长，我于2000年开始职业生涯。

sentences.en: So now it's already 26 years in the shipping.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我在航运业已经26年了。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma has sailed through the Strait of Hormuz dozens of times.
sentences.zh: 维什瓦卡马船长曾几十次航行穿过霍尔木兹海峡。

sentences.en: But before the war began, he said the wider world didn't know much about it.
sentences.zh: 但战争爆发前，他说外界对这个地方并不太了解。

sentences.en: It's a relatively small body of water that's basically the doorway to the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 这是一片相对较小的水域，基本上是波斯湾的大门。

sentences.en: At its narrowest point, it's only about 21 miles wide.
sentences.zh: 在其最狭窄处，宽度仅约21英里。

sentences.en: But in that sliver of ocean, there's a bustling waterway.
sentences.zh: 但在那片狭长的海洋中，却有一条繁忙的水路。

sentences.en: The Strait is one of the world's most critical energy corridors.
sentences.zh: 这条海峡是世界上最重要的能源走廊之一。

sentences.en: It's responsible for 20% of the world's oil and natural gas supply.
sentences.zh: 它承担着全球20%的石油和天然气供应。

sentences.en: More than 100 ships pass through it every day.
sentences.zh: 每天有100多艘船只通过这里。

sentences.en: We have container ships, we have cargo ships, we have crude oil, we have vegetable soil ships, we have chemical tankers.
sentences.zh: 我们有集装箱船、货船、原油船、植物油船、化学品船。

sentences.en: Then all the ships are carrying different things.
sentences.zh: 所有的船只都在运输不同的东西。

sentences.en: We are taking the gas, we are taking the petrols, we are taking the gasoline.
sentences.zh: 我们运载天然气，我们运载汽油，我们运载车用汽油。

sentences.en: And they are taking from one place to another place and giving to the world.
sentences.zh: 它们把这些从一个地方运到另一个地方，供给全世界。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma's ship is an LPG tanker.
sentences.zh: 维什瓦卡马船长的船是一艘液化石油气船。

sentences.en: That's liquefied petroleum gas.
sentences.zh: 也就是液化石油气。

sentences.en: His ship takes it back to India, where people use the butane and propane for heating, cooking, and fuel for cars.
sentences.zh: 他的船将这些运回印度，人们将其中的丁烷和丙烷用于取暖、做饭以及汽车燃料。

sentences.en: He says he loves the work.
sentences.zh: 他说他热爱这份工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, because it's a good job and a prestigious job.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为这是一份好工作，也是一份有声望的工作。

sentences.en: Plus, we can move the world economy.
sentences.zh: 另外，我们能推动世界经济运转。

sentences.en: The idea is basically that you're keeping the world economy moving.
sentences.zh: 这个概念基本上就是，你在让世界经济保持运转。

sentences.en: That's what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 你指的就是这个意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, that is right.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样。

sentences.en: So, suppose if you buy a Christmas gift from China, it should reach to New York on 24th of December.
sentences.zh: 所以，假设你从中国买了一件圣诞礼物，它应该在12月24日到达纽约。

sentences.en: So, our job is to make sure that it will reach on 24th of December, not 25th or 26th.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作就是确保它在12月24日到达，而不是25日或26日。

sentences.en: So, our importance in the world economy is, if the seafarer will not take, then the whole world will be stopped.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在世界经济中的重要性在于，如果海员不运送，整个世界都会停摆。

sentences.en: So, a few months back, on February 28th, it was just another day at work.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，也就是2月28日，那只是工作中平常的一天。

sentences.en: His ship had made it to the port of Kuwait, and his crew had started loading the butane and propane onto the ship.
sentences.zh: 他的船已经到达科威特港，船员们开始将丁烷和丙烷装上船。

sentences.en: So, at 1700 hours, I heard a sound.
sentences.zh: 所以在1700点，我听到了一声响声。

sentences.en: And that's where he was when the war started.
sentences.zh: 这就是战争爆发时他所在的地方。

sentences.en: Like, boom!
sentences.zh: 就像，轰的一声！

sentences.en: I thought maybe the crew has banging the door.
sentences.zh: 我以为可能是船员在砰砰关门。

sentences.en: But again, I hear the same thing.
sentences.zh: 但接着我又听到了同样的动静。

sentences.en: So, I thought it could not be possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这不太可能。

sentences.en: So, I went on the bridge.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了驾驶台。

sentences.en: Bridge is the part of the ship where we navigate the ship.
sentences.zh: 驾驶台是船上用来导航的部分。

sentences.en: All the navigation equipment, all the parts are there on the bridge where we navigate.
sentences.zh: 所有的导航设备、所有的部件都在驾驶台，我们在那里航行。

sentences.en: So, I run on the bridge.
sentences.zh: 所以我跑向驾驶台。

sentences.en: I saw all the missiles continuously.
sentences.zh: 我看到密集的导弹接连不断。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美军

sentences.en: base is intercepting the drones and the missiles.
sentences.zh: 基地正在拦截无人机和导弹。

sentences.en: Whoa, you could see missiles from the bridge where you were standing?
sentences.zh: 哇，你站在驾驶台就能看到导弹？

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: Then, the debris are falling near to our vessels, and the vibration was very high.
sentences.zh: 然后，残骸落在了我们船附近，震动非常强烈。

sentences.en: All my crew were panicked then, after seeing that.
sentences.zh: 看到那一幕后，我所有的船员都恐慌了。

sentences.en: And I was shivering.
sentences.zh: 我在发抖。

sentences.en: I was shivering, and I was in the shock.
sentences.zh: 我在发抖，而且陷入了震惊。

sentences.en: What to do?
sentences.zh: 该怎么办？

sentences.en: Captain, did you know what was happening?
sentences.zh: 船长，你知道发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Like, did you have any idea what was going on at this point?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，当时你对正在发生的事情有什么概念吗？

sentences.en: You know, when the day started, we are clueless.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当这一天开始时，我们完全一无所知。

sentences.en: Why it is happening?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: What is the reason behind that?
sentences.zh: 背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: Where it is coming and where it is going, we don't know, actually.
sentences.zh: 它们是从哪来又往哪去，其实我们都不知道。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, after that, I informed my company.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，我通知了我的公司。

sentences.en: And the big bosses from the company, they said that if you, Captain, feel unsafe, you take out the vessel.
sentences.zh: 公司的高层说，船长，如果你觉得不安全，就把船开出去。

sentences.en: We are with you.
sentences.zh: 我们支持你。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma wanted to get his crew out of there, and he wanted to stop loading the fuel onto the ship.
sentences.zh: 维什瓦卡马船长想把他的船员带离那里，他想停止向船上装载燃料。

sentences.en: Because if they got hit, the cargo could turn his ship into a massive bomb.
sentences.zh: 因为如果被击中，船上的货物可能会把他的船变成一颗巨大的炸弹。

sentences.en: We have almost 6,000, 7,000 of metric ton of propane butane on board ship.
sentences.zh: 我们船上几乎有6,000到7,000公吨的丙烷丁烷。

sentences.en: So, if support something is fall on our ship, it will be a bigger disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以万一有什么东西落在我们的船上，那将是一场巨大的灾难。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, you were literally worried, it sounds like at this point, that your ship could blow up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听起来你当时真的担心你的船会爆炸。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But when he told the terminal authorities that he wasn't going to keep loading, they pushed back.
sentences.zh: 但当他告诉码头当局他不会继续装载时，遭到了一方反对。

sentences.en: Can you take the cargo?
sentences.zh: 你能运走这些货物吗？

sentences.en: They wanted him to take the cargo.
sentences.zh: 他们想让他把货物带走。

sentences.en: See, if something happens, then it will wipe out the full terminal and everything.
sentences.zh: 你看，如果发生什么事，那将摧毁整个码头和一切。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Every 10 minutes, 10 drones, 10 missiles, they're firing.
sentences.zh: 每隔10分钟，就有10架无人机、10枚导弹在发射。

sentences.en: He said the drones and the missiles kept coming.
sentences.zh: 他说无人机和导弹接连不断。

sentences.en: Bigger than what happened before.
sentences.zh: 比以前发生的还要猛烈。

sentences.en: So, he eventually finished loading the cargo.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终完成了货物的装载。

sentences.en: It took hours.
sentences.zh: 这花了几个小时。

sentences.en: And then got out.
sentences.zh: 然后离开了。

sentences.en: And then after that, we have out from that place.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们离开了那个地方。

sentences.en: We go with a maximum speed.
sentences.zh: 我们以最大速度行驶。

sentences.en: And on the way, our GPS was not working.
sentences.zh: 在路上，我们的GPS无法工作。

sentences.en: There was no GPS signal.
sentences.zh: 没有GPS信号。

sentences.en: There was nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: We did our navigation totally on the basic what we learn in our college.
sentences.zh: 我们完全依靠在大学里学到的基础知识来进行导航。

sentences.en: Then we dropped anchor near Abu Musa Island.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在阿布穆萨岛附近抛锚。

sentences.en: Near Dubai.
sentences.zh: 迪拜附近。

sentences.en: Near Dubai.
sentences.zh: 迪拜附近。

sentences.en: He anchored at the edge of the strait.
sentences.zh: 他在海峡边缘抛锚。

sentences.en: And as the days passed, the attacks kept coming.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，袭击还在继续。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma said his crew watched as rockets hit an island about 10 miles away.
sentences.zh: 维什瓦卡马船长说，他的船员目睹了火箭弹击中大约10英里外的一座岛屿。

sentences.en: It was engulfed in flames.
sentences.zh: 它被烈火吞噬了。

sentences.en: We are seeing the flames.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了火焰。

sentences.en: We are seeing the smokes.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了浓烟。

sentences.en: So, we are just thinking, if they miss anything, it will be fired to us also.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是在想，如果他们有什么打偏了，也会落到我们头上。

sentences.en: The constant noise and vibrations were stressful.
sentences.zh: 持续的噪音和震动令人压力巨大。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 维什瓦卡马船长无法入睡。

sentences.en: He said his crew was having panic attacks, worried one of those missiles could hit the ship.
sentences.zh: 他说他的船员们都出现了恐慌发作，担心其中一枚导弹会击中船只。

sentences.en: And they were turning to him for answers.
sentences.zh: 而他们正向他寻求答案。

sentences.en: If they feel unsafe, they call me.
sentences.zh: 如果他们觉得不安全，就会打电话给我。

sentences.en: Captain, what to do?
sentences.zh: 船长，该怎么办？

sentences.en: But we cannot do much about that.
sentences.zh: 但对此我们做不了太多。

sentences.en: And were you in touch with any other captains?
sentences.zh: 你和其他船长有过联系吗？

sentences.en: Did you know how they were dealing with this?
sentences.zh: 你知道他们是怎么应对这情况的吗？

sentences.en: So, every day we are talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每天都在互相交谈。

sentences.en: Every day we share our feelings.
sentences.zh: 每天我们都在分享彼此的感受。

sentences.en: What are the things happening in your company?
sentences.zh: 你们公司发生了什么事？

sentences.en: And what is your crew saying?
sentences.zh: 你们的船员是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So that we feel safe.
sentences.zh: 这样我们能感到安全一些。

sentences.en: Like, we have one captain on another ship.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们在另一艘船上有一位船长。

sentences.en: And he's a 56 years old captain.
sentences.zh: 他是一位56岁的船长。

sentences.en: And every day he is calling me.
sentences.zh: 他每天都打电话给我。

sentences.en: Captain, what is your company is doing?
sentences.zh: 船长，你们公司在做什么？

sentences.en: Because my company is a little bit established company.
sentences.zh: 因为我的公司是一家稍微有规模的公司。

sentences.en: And his company is not that much established.
sentences.zh: 而他的公司没有那么大的规模。

sentences.en: So, he asks me every day.
sentences.zh: 所以他每天都问我。

sentences.en: Captain, what are your companies saying?
sentences.zh: 船长，你们公司是怎么说的？

sentences.en: When you are going to cross?
sentences.zh: 你们什么时候准备穿越？

sentences.en: It sounds like he was trying to get some advice from you.
sentences.zh: 听起来他试图从你这里得到一些建议。

sentences.en: Like, some guidance about what to do in this scenario.
sentences.zh: 比如，关于在这种情况下该怎么做的某种指导。

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: Because nobody is expected this thing will happen.
sentences.zh: 因为谁也没想到会发生这种事。

sentences.en: But after maybe 10 days, 15 days, our hope was, like, gone.
sentences.zh: 但大概过了10天、15天后，我们的希望就差不多破灭了。

sentences.en: That we are stranded and nobody will be going to help.
sentences.zh: 意识到我们被困住了，而且没有人会来帮忙。

sentences.en: Did you feel as though, I mean, and it sounds like you were, very much out there on your own?
sentences.zh: 你当时是不是觉得——我是说，听起来确实如此——你只能孤军奋战？

sentences.en: Alone?
sentences.zh: 孤身一人？

sentences.en: Yeah, that is right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: That is right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because if something happens, definitely nobody is going to help us.
sentences.zh: 因为如果发生什么事，绝对没有人会来救我们。

sentences.en: And every day, my wife, my son and daughter, they call,
sentences.zh: 而且每天，我妻子、我儿子和女儿都会打电话来，

sentences.en: Papa, when you are coming back home.
sentences.zh: “爸爸，你什么时候回家？”

sentences.en: Every day, they call.
sentences.zh: 他们每天都打电话。

sentences.en: But I don't have an answer to give.
sentences.zh: 但我给不出答案。

sentences.en: What answer to should I give?
sentences.zh: 我该回答什么呢？

sentences.en: How old are your children?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子多大了？

sentences.en: What did it feel like to not be able to tell them, Papa's coming home soon?
sentences.zh: 无法告诉他们“爸爸很快就要回家了”，当时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: My son is 10 years old and my daughter is 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 我儿子10岁，女儿12岁。

sentences.en: Then, yeah, I feel very bad about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我对此感到非常难过。

sentences.en: But what to do?
sentences.zh: 但能怎么办呢？

sentences.en: We cannot go out from there.
sentences.zh: 我们无法离开那里。

sentences.en: We are in the, you can say that, in a jail.
sentences.zh: 我们身处其中，可以说是关在大牢里。

sentences.en: You felt like you were in a jail, like you were imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己像是在坐牢，就像被监禁了一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, that is right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，就是这样。

sentences.en: But I said, OK, I will come back safely.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉自己，没关系，我会平安回去的。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: Every day, I have to give these hopes to my family.
sentences.zh: 每天，我都必须给家人这样的希望。

sentences.en: Captain Vishwakarma was at a loss.
sentences.zh: 维斯瓦卡马船长一筹莫展。

sentences.en: He couldn't leave.

sentences.en: Israel widened its offensive in Lebanon on Thursday, striking the capital, Beirut, for the first time in nearly a month.
sentences.zh: 以色列周四扩大了在黎巴嫩的攻势，近一个月来首次空袭了首都贝鲁特。

sentences.en: The Israeli military said that it had struck more than 135 targets that belonged to Hezbollah in a 24-hour period.

sentences.en: And Anthropic, once a lesser-known artificial intelligence company, punctuated its stunning rise with eye-popping news on Thursday.

sentences.en: It said it had reached a valuation of $900 billion after its latest funding round, overtaking OpenAI to become the most valuable AI startup in the world.
